source_title: Sigma' OTT review: Vijay's son Jason Sanjay's film gets mixed reactions
source_excerpt: Thalapathy Vijay's son Jason Sanjay's directorial debut, 'Sigma', has sparked a discussion among moviegoers following its OTT release. Starring Sundeep Kishan in the lead role, the Tamil heist-action thriller premiered on Netflix on October 30, bringing the film to audiences who may have missed its theatrical run. While Jason Sanjay's debut had generated considerable curiosity, the film has received mixed reactions from OTT viewers. Several viewers have praised Sundeep Kishan's performance and the visuals, while others have expressed disappointment with the screenplay and execution.Fans share mixed reactions to Jason Sanjay's 'Sigma'Following its Netflix premiere on October 30, viewers took to social media to share their opinions on 'Sigma'. While some appreciated Sundeep Kishan's performance and the film's visual appeal, others felt that the screenplay failed to make the most of its heist premise.One viewer expressed strong disappointment with the film, writing, "Sorryâ¦. Sanjayâ¦. SIGMAâ¦.. Seriyanaâ¦.. Sothappalâ¦.. Sambhavamâ¦. Senjiuteengaâ¦.." Another viewer described it as a below-average film, pointing out that the screenplay and narration failed to hold attention despite an interesting central concept and some decent visuals.Sundeep Kishan's performance gets attention, but weak screenplay disappoints viewersSundeep Kishan's performance has emerged as one of the few aspects of the film that viewers have widely appreciated. Some audience members liked his energy, comic timing and action sequences. One viewer wrote, âThe biggest asset of this movie is Sundeep Kishan, in addition to the screen presence of Sampath Raj and comic sequences."However, the same reviewer pointed out that the film suffered from underdeveloped characters, forced comedy and uneven pacing. Another viewer felt that while 'Sigma' looked visually appealing, it lacked engaging content. The heist sequences, in particular, were criticised for failing to generate enough excitement, even when watched on OTT.What is 'Sigma' about?'Sigma' follows Guru, a man struggling with financial difficulties who runs a library in memory of his late mother. His life takes an unexpected turn when he gets drawn into a risky operation to steal a hidden fortune worth hundreds of crores from a gambling gang. Blending action, crime, comedy and emotional drama, the film follows his journey as the heist unfolds.Sundeep Kishan plays the lead role, while Faria Abdullah, Raju Sundaram, Sampath Raj, Anbu Thasan, Yogi Babu and Sheila Rajkumar feature in supporting roles. Thaman S has composed the music, with Krishnan Vasant handling the cinematography.With its Netflix release, 'Sigma' is now accessible to a wider audience, giving Jason Sanjay's first film as a director another opportunity to find viewers. However, the initial OTT response remains divided.
